response.note: Hourly card attempt volume and success rate on 2026-09-18 by payment method; the method_family value 'CARD' and status value 'SUCCESS' are assumed, so verify them against the data if results look empty.
response.sql: SELECT hour_of_day, payment_method, COUNT(*) AS attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successes, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS success_rate_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failures FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-18' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-19' AND method_family = 'CARD' GROUP BY hour_of_day, payment_method ORDER BY hour_of_day, payment_method LIMIT 50
